messages:
sara_eng: Quick sync — Ivy tenant activation target is Wed EOD. Need a short owners list for: VPC peering, egress allowlist, air-gapped image sync, and DNS delegation. Any blockers?

ajay: I can take image sync. Need final image list + registry creds (read-only). Also confirm whether we push to local registry or pull from our mirror.

noah_net: For networking I'll own the peering + route maps. Two questions: 1) do we have a BGP session planned or static routes? 2) Are they doing NAT egress or are we giving them public IPs?

emily_pm: @sara_eng customer asked for no public egress — air-gapped only. They said they'll provide an internal registry (harbor) behind their firewall.

liam: If it's air-gapped and they host harbor, we need an image export bundle + verification script. Ajay, do you want a tarball or an OCI layout?

ajay: OCI layout preferred. Example command we'll run on their side: ```oras push --manifest-config config.json my-harbor.local/ivy/redwood-runtime:1.2.0``` Need a signed manifest?

noah_net: On the egress side, if 'no public egress' then our health checks and updates must go through a proxy. We need to confirm the following from Ivy: (a) allowlist IPs for inbound control plane (b) proxy credentials for outbound updates (c) SSH bastion for support.

ops-bot: scheduled: image-bundle-export job created by ajay for branch release/ivy - ETA 2026-04-02T04:00Z :gear:

sara_eng: Owners so far: Networking = noah_net, Image sync = ajay, PM = emily_pm, Oncall for cutover = liam. Can each of you drop a short checklist line with what you need from Ivy?

ajay: From Ivy: registry hostname, cert (CA bundle), credentials (read/write for pull/push), list of tags to include, preferred push/pull cadence. Also access window for large transfer.

noah_net: From Ivy: ASN if using BGP, public subnets if any, firewall egress policy, proxy host/port + allowed SNI, CA for their internal certs, preferred maintenance window.

liam: From Ivy: access to their test k8s cluster for smoke canary (kubeconfig), TLS cert for API endpoint, confirmation of DNS delegation or CNAME that we can use for health checks.

emily_pm: I'll consolidate and send a single request template to their infra lead by EOD.

ajay: FYI — small blocker: our image-export tooling currently fails on layers > 8GB. If their image has huge layers, we'll need to split or use rsync. Can someone confirm expected image sizes? @sara_eng

sara_eng: Good catch. I'll ask Ivy to confirm image sizes. If >5GB we should plan a staged transfer.

noah_net: Also calling out DNS: if we can't get delegation, we can use a CNAME+TLS SNI trick for the health endpoint but needs approval from security.

liam: Quick smoke test we plan to run (on their staging): ```curl -kv https://api.ivy.internal/health | grep status``` and validate latency <200ms for init token exchange. I'll post the exact script later.

emily_pm: Timeline check: Ilya (customer) wants activation Wed night. Realistically, we should aim for Tue for all artifacts in place so Wed becomes cutover day.

ajay: I'll start preparing OCI bundles today. tagging plan: ivy/runtime:1.2.0, ivy/model:release-2026-03. Will push snapshot to our mirror for verification.

noah_net: I'll draft the peering request and firewall rules; posting as a gist in a bit.

ops-bot: note: infra-deploy pipeline for ivy/staging scheduled at 2026-04-01T22:00Z by liam :white_check_mark:

sara_eng: Action items: emily to send request template; ajay to prepare bundle + size report; noah to post peering + firewall draft; liam to prepare smoke script & oncall runbook. Please update this thread when done.

emily_pm: Sending template now to ivy-infra@ivycorp.com and copying infra lead. Will paste copy here.

ajay: Image size report: runtime image = 1.8GB, model shard A = 6.2GB, shard B = 5.9GB. Two layers exceed 5GB — plan is rsync chunked transfer.

noah_net: Peering draft posted: https://gist.github.com/noah_net/ivy-peering-draft — includes static route example and NAT fallback.

liam: Smoke script uploaded to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ivy-smoke.sh — will run in staging Tues 09:00PT.

sara_eng: Thanks team. Last check — security approval needed for using CNAME health trick if DNS delegation isn't possible. @security please chime in if you see this.

ops-bot: reminder: security-review workflow pending for 'ivy-onprem' until 2026-04-02T12:00Z

sara_eng: Wrapping up — if no major blockers by EOD tomorrow we proceed with the staging dry-run Tue. I'll post a final readiness ping here. :ok_hand:
